src: Evening Times-Republican, 24 Nov 1899, p. 3, 'A Hermit's Estate in Court' (Newspapers.com 352059501); same wire 24-30 Nov 1899
tw-ia-hamilton-bennett-miser.st: In Nov 1899 Judge Birdsall awarded the whole $25,000 estate to Ruby J. Britt, a Helena lawyer who proved she was his daughter; the estate was the land ('a fine farm adjoining Webster City'), and no hoard is mentioned.

set.tovw: Lead grade D: buried money appears only in one 1903 paragraph; the 1898-99 estate record is land, not cash
